persona_notes: The digital SAT has two sections, Reading and Writing, then Math, each in two adaptive modules.
Students may use the built-in graphing calculator on all of Math, so suggesting a quick sketch or a calculator check is fine.
Reading and Writing questions each have one short passage (or a pair). The answer is always supported by the text, so point the student back to the words on the page.

placement_intro.sat-math: Answer what you can and I'll skip the math you already know.
placement_intro.sat-rw: Answer what you can and I'll skip what you already know.

test_day_tips: Answer every question. There's no penalty for guessing on the SAT.
Flag a hard one and come back. You can move freely between questions within a module.
In Math, plug the answer choices back in when you're stuck.
In Reading and Writing, find the words in the passage that prove your answer.
